caption: The drawing depicts a lace pattern rendered in black ink on a light beige background. The design is symmetrical, with a scalloped edge that frames the lace, curving inward at the bottom center and outward along the sides. The lace itself features a complex network of hexagonal mesh, interspersed with floral motifs consisting of stylized flowers and leaves. Larger flowers are distributed evenly, with smaller circular elements filling the spaces between them. There are several parallel decorative border bands near the edge, each composed of repeating circular and floral elements. The central bottom part is accentuated by a larger, more detailed flower motif. The composition occupies the central area of the rectangular page, bordered by two fine, straight lines near the edges of the paper.
title: Lace Scarf
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
